subject: Rate-limit or debounce POST /verify on the bc2 claim service. Grading moved server-side (correct), but every 'Check My Work' click is now 2 real OpenStack API calls against live Nova/Cinder where it used to be a local docker exec. A class mashing the button generates control-plane load that did not exist before. Deliberately NOT solved with caching -- grading must reflect live state, a cached pass is a wrong pass. Wanted before a full class uses it simultaneously. Raised by Nancy 2026-07-30 as a blast-radius consequence of the fix itself.
